markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class set, both models agree, all five neighbors Benign [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%; others <1% | Clearly separated |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, Benign | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign | Full agreement |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scored low; leans non-invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Scored high; leans non-invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Gland/tubule formation** (regions 1, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored high; leans non-invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scored low; leans non-invasive · Validated
- **Neoplastic-labelled nuclei, 70%** (regions 0, 2, 4) · context · 96th percentile versus reference [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Leans on duct-confined (Weak, 12/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Neoplastic-nuclei fraction (96th percentile) is unusual for Benign; only three regions were segmented.
- Calibration tested on 132 images, 24 patient groups; ECE interval wide (0.03–0.18).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 4** — Confirm labelled neoplastic nuclei are atypical, not reactive epithelium.
2. **Regions 5, 7, 8** — Look for intraductal atypical cells; concept spot check was weak.
3. **Region 3** — Confirm stroma holds no infiltrating tumor.
